title: What lives inside the mile-deep rock that hasn't seen the sun in two billion years?
angle: The episode hooks viewers by exploring the bizarre, shadow-dwelling ecosystems thriving deep beneath Earth's crust, revealing how life survives entirely on radiation rather than sunlight and transforming our understanding of where life could exist in the universe.
description: An engaging 8-10 minute science explainer exploring the bizarre deep subsurface biosphere of Earth, where microbes survive without sunlight on radioactive energy, completely rewriting our understanding of life's limits and its potential across the universe.
